slot_note: seed ET02 (13F institutional ownership bridge: amendment types, filing-date value units, option rows, CUSIP repair). The seed's stump was rule application and data semantics, so it is re-rooted: the seed's mechanics stay as Layer 1 mess carried by the asks, and the decisive step is a Layer 2 censoring construction, completing a filing period whose 45-day window is still open at the extract.
niche: an independent ownership-research firm's quarterly crowded-ownership flag on a client watchlist, set from the SEC Form 13F structured data sets while the quarter's filing window is still open, so the flag has to rest on the institutional ownership the completed filing set will show
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms every Q4 2022 13F filing correctly (amendment types, value units by filing date, option rows out, CUSIPs repaired) computes institutional ownership on the filings received by the extract, or scales every issuer by one aggregate share of value historically on file by that day, and flags the wrong set of watchlist issuers, because managers that filed for Q3 and have not yet filed for Q4 are holders not yet reported, not zero holders, and they sit in some issuers' registers far more than in others.
domain_test: The flag turns on ownership-data practice specific to 13F: holdings arrive over a 45-day window, filing lag tracks manager type (large passive complexes and multi-strategy funds file at the deadline), positions of slow filers persist quarter to quarter, and ownership is measured in shares against the issuer's cover-page shares outstanding; put another field's nouns in and the censoring structure, the carry-forward of a manager's last filed position and the shares denominator have nothing to attach to.
layer1: holdings filings with reporting lags and amendments (originals, RESTATEMENT and NEW HOLDINGS amendments, filing dates)
value reported in thousands of dollars before 2023-01-03 and in dollars after, by filing date, with a filer still in thousands after the switch
put and call rows and principal-amount rows on the same CUSIP as the shares
filer-keyed CUSIPs with dropped leading zeros, lower case and a bad check digit
the SEC data sets organised by the quarter a filing was submitted, not the period it reports
shares outstanding from cover pages of 10-K and 10-Q filings with different as-of dates
manager families filing under several CIKs, and 13F notice filers
stakeholder_role: head of ownership research at an independent ownership-research firm that publishes a quarterly crowded flag to hedge fund clients

spine.file: INFOTABLE.tsv (one per 13F data set drop: 2022q3, 2022q4, 2023q1 to the extract)
spine.entity: one information-table line of one 13F filing (one security position, or put or call, as one manager reported it in one accession)
spine.source: synthetic, on the SEC Form 13F data set schema

world.org_type: independent ownership-research firm serving hedge fund clients

driver: The decisive quantity is the part of a period's total still held by reporters whose reports have not arrived at the extract; because slow reporters concentrate in some units and not others, it has to be completed reporter by reporter from each one's last report, and reading the arrived reports as the total, or scaling every unit by one aggregate completion share, misstates exactly the units whose holders report late and changes which units cross the threshold.
driver_concrete: At the extract the Q4 2022 13F window (deadline 2023-02-14) is still open; managers that filed for Q3 but not yet for Q4 are mostly large passive complexes and multi-strategy funds that file at the deadline, and they hold a very different share of each watchlist issuer, so the flag rests on Q4 holdings on file plus each pending manager carried at its last filed share position (back-tested on the Q2 and Q3 windows at the same day), not on the filings in hand or one aggregate completion factor.
stump: A competent solver conforms the Q4 13F filings in hand perfectly and flags the issuers whose institutional ownership on file clears 80 per cent of shares outstanding, or, seeing the window open, grosses every issuer up by the aggregate share of value historically on file by that day; both file the wrong flag set, because the step that decides it is completing the period holder by holder, and the pending managers' last filed positions are concentrated in a few issuers' registers (issuer names fixed at build).
notes: subdomain other: institutional ownership analytics from regulatory holdings filings, which the quantitative-finance task-type list does not carry. forcing_event other: the firm's quarterly flag file is published to clients on a fixed date inside the filing window. decisive_rule_filed true: the firm's methodology note files the estimand (ownership on the complete filing set for the period, every manager that files for it) and the 13F deadline; it does not say how to complete a period before the deadline, which is the construction the data force.
